project.title: Predictive Community Food Rescue
project.short_description: SurplusSync helps donors find eligible community recipients for surplus food with explainable feasibility checks, rescue planning, and volunteer coordination. SQLite runs the workflow, with optional IBM Db2 and LangChain analysis.

members.name: Rajat Rajput
members.role: Creator; full-stack implementation and Db2/LangChain integration

ibm_db2.edition: Optional IBM Db2 instance; live environment and connectivity not verified
features_used: Optional parameterized JSON snapshot upsert and read-back verification
SURPLUSSYNC_AI_RECORDS table with listing, candidate, and assessment record types
Runtime connection status endpoint; SSL-required connection configuration
Retrieved Db2 records supplied as LangChain explanation context

ai_models: IBM watsonx.ai Granite model configured by WATSONX_MODEL_ID when credentials are supplied; otherwise deterministic LangChain rules-only summary
